steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Why are you crying again? Was someone mean to you?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: It's him. His hand was so burning hot, and he destroyed the illusory realm I gave him! Sob...
steps.female_content: It's her. Her hand was so burning hot, and she destroyed the illusory realm I gave her! Sob...

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: You said everyone loved Hamel. I've already become Hamel. Why would he treat me like that?
steps.female_content: You said everyone loved Hamel. I've already become Hamel. Why would she treat me like that?

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: You're Hamel. We love you. So many of us in the amusement park love you.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: But he didn't want to play with me. And he grabbed my hand like this, and trapped me with a circle of red spikes!
steps.female_content: But she didn't want to play with me. And she grabbed my hand like this, and trapped me with a circle of red spikes!

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Because it's the real you who he's dying to see.
steps.female_content: Because it's the real you who she's dying to see.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: You're a phantom, a body double. You forgot that? The real you didn't get hurt. You know that, right?
The man soothes Hamel as if she were a baby. You hear Hella make a gagging noise.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Oh... That's right! He didn't hurt me!
steps.female_content: Oh... That's right! She didn't hurt me!

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Then he definitely likes me. Right?
steps.female_content: Then she definitely likes me. Right?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: I knew it. He has the same powers as me. He's my companion! He definitely likes me!
steps.female_content: I knew it. She has the same powers as me. She's my companion! She definitely likes me!

steps.content: Hamel seems to live in a world of her own. The man strokes her head affectionately.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Of course. He's here to see you. So what do you say we go back and wait for him?
steps.female_content: Of course. She's here to see you. So what do you say we go back and wait for her?

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Okay! I'll wait for him, he's my friend. Don't kill him, okay?
steps.female_content: Okay! I'll wait for her, she's my friend. Don't kill her, okay?

steps.content: Phantom Hamel turns to you, excitement writ large on her face.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Come and find me! The real me!
You make no response to the invitation. The phantom dissipates there and then, leaving the man behind.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: You should've been gentler to her. She's only a kid... A lonely kid.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You mean a kid who has the blood of so many on her hands?

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Give her a chance to grow. She came to this world all too soon, so soon that we didn't even know she was already here and missed the opportunity to nurture her properly.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: She wandered here all by herself, looking for companionship and love. She grew her power bit by bit and unleashed the Black Ring on her own. Don't you think that's praiseworthy?

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: But someone kept standing in her way.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I see... Those men in black raincoats were not humans. They were let in here as fodder for this evil will.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You let her absorb contamination and sully the other illusory amusement park, so that she could break the restraints put on her by the real Hamel and set herself free.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You intensified Mania by feeding the dark side of human nature to trigger the Black Ring. Did you do the same thing to Zoya?!

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: You're smart. But that's not what happened to Zoya.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Oh, tell me something first, Chief. Quid pro quo. Tell me what happened at the top of the statue.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Who</color> was there besides Zoya? What was she doing up there...? Where did she go after that...? Who destroyed the Black Ring I had painstakingly nurtured?
His face wears an obnoxious grin, his voice grows frigid.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I have no interest in dealing with people like you.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: The answer is very important to me.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: ...You shall tell me.
The shadows around his feet spread out, leap out of the ground to attack you, but are cut in half by Nightmare. But there's more to come.
A large number of black flame-carrying tentacles flow out of the underside of his umbrella, drop onto the ground, and transmute into men in black raincoats.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>Corpus</color> here is being awakened. Nothing is going to derail it this time.
